card.name: Break points in numbers and sections
card.fires_on: Spaces, periods and single digits at a break point in label text, such as before a section number, inside a statistic like a confidence interval, or between a number and its unit.

modes.label: Inside statistics
modes.description: A digit or space in a risk ratio, confidence interval or IC50 value.

modes.label: Sentence end before a new section
modes.description: A period or space that ends a sentence just before a numbered heading.

modes.label: Space before an exponent
modes.description: A space between a number and a power-of-ten term in lab values.

card.plain: It fires at small gaps and punctuation inside numbers and between label sections, not on a particular medical word.
